summary: the cases of tests/run drill under etude, against a kernel whose whole-disk window opens for writing over a mounted root, a bootctl that will not save recovery as the default, and a recovery image whose rescue-static takes another fixed address

argv: sh tests/proofs/guest.sh make rach2 utils rach2-recovery-image && sh tests/proofs/guest.sh copy ${WORK} rach2/kernel utils/sbin/bootctl && sh tests/proofs/guest.sh exec ${WORK} sh -c 'tag=; [ ! -f krffs/recovery_authorized_keys ] || tag=-with-key; rm -f "$1/rescue-static" && build/krffs/readfile.krffs "$ARCH_BUILD/images/rach2-recovery$tag.krffs" /bin/rescue-static "$1/rescue-static"' sh ${WORK}

faults.name: claim-ignored
faults.summary: a write-capable open of a raw window does not look for a mounted volume's claim on its range

faults.name: no-saved-recovery
faults.summary: bootctl refuses recovery as the saved default

faults.name: other-address
faults.summary: rescue-static gives eth0 192.168.0.106 in place of the fixed address it logs
